_metadata.description: Chrome-DevTools-style visual filters applied to the preview iframe: color-scheme toggle and vision filters (blur, grayscale, three colorblindness modes).

requirements.title: Color-scheme toggle (system/light/dark) posts a class to the harness child via the bridge
requirements.description: The Appearance & visual checks menu provides a three-way System/Light/Dark control that posts the resolved color-scheme state to each harness child. The harness applies `color-scheme: <value>` on `:root` and toggles a `dark` class as needed; token packs remain a separate CSS-token override axis.

validation.notes: UI component test toggles the control, asserts the bridge message is posted with the expected payload.

requirements.title: Vision-filter dropdown applies SVG-defined filters to the iframe
requirements.description: The Appearance & visual checks menu offers none, blur (0–10px), grayscale, protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia. Hidden SVG `<filter>` defs on the host page are composed into `filter: url(#...)` on the iframe wrapper. Colorblindness matrices match `app-monitor`'s `DeviceVisionFilterDefs`.

validation.notes: Component test asserts dropdown selection updates the wrapper's `filter` CSS to the expected `url(#...)` value.
